name: Blasphemy-Spawn (Curseborn Tiefling)
body:
Some tieflings have both fiendish and celestial origins, marking them as anathema to the forces of Good and Evil alike.

Alternate Ability Score You gain +2 Int, +2 Wis, –2 Con.
Alternate Skill Modifiers Knowledge (planes), Sense Motive.
Spell-Like Ability At 1st level, choose darkness, daylight, or any alternate spell-like ability available to an aasimar or tiefling heritage. You can use this spell-like ability once per day. This trait alters spell-like ability and replaces fiendish sorcery.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
